payload.content: An admin-only WordPress developer tool for previewing, applying and rolling back structured JSON patch packages, with production patching blocked by default unless explicitly enabled.
payload.description_1: AI Patch Runner deals with a high-risk WordPress task: applying structured code changes to installed plugins without turning the admin area into an unrestricted file editor. A bad patch can break functionality, so speed is less important than knowing what changes, who applies it and how to recover if the result is wrong.
payload.description_2: I designed AI Patch Runner as an admin-only workflow for structured JSON patch packages. Preview is kept separate from execution so a proposed change can be inspected before plugin files are modified. Relevant actions remain close to the information needed for the next step.
